text: Airbnb priced its IPO on December 9, 2020 at $68 a share and closed its first day at $144.71. The stock peaked at $216.84 on February 11, 2021, fell to a low of $82.49 on December 28, 2022, and closed the five years at $133.78 on December 17, 2025, 96.7% above the offer price. Its filings show revenue collapsing in the pandemic, then reaching records as travel returned, with growth slowing after the rebound.
